iAs.rationale: iAs carries no product-specific sovereign cell; it is a component of and bounded by its parent total tAs (iAs <= tAs), an enforceable ceiling via reflex speciation rather than an empty cell.
iAs.reference_method: iAs speciation reflexed when the parent total reaches min(species limit, 50 percent of the parent-total limit); the species never substitutes for the parent-total report.

Sn.label: Sn 250000 ug/kg: disclosed read-across from SG sg_foodregs_2026_any_food_sn_250000 (any food). Filled by the completeness sweep; nearest applicable sovereign for this matrix and basis.

Cr.basis_note: nearest sovereign value, face value (disclosed read-across; no government ML for this product form)
